# Kodable.ai

> A small Spain-based studio that uses AI to scale small local businesses, wherever they are. We build fast websites and AI agents that answer customers 24/7. Site available in five languages: English, Español, Français, Deutsch and Italiano. Free, no-pressure consultation; real people who answer after launch.

## Services
- [All services](https://kodable.ai/en/services): Websites, AI agents, custom tools and automations.
- [Websites](https://kodable.ai/en/services/websites): Fast, AI-built sites that show up when people search nearby and turn a curious visitor into a booking.
- [AI Agents](https://kodable.ai/en/services/ai-agents): A friendly assistant that answers customers, takes bookings and handles reception on WhatsApp and your site, 24/7.
